# Research Hub — Juan Moisés de la Serna Tuya

> Central hub for open datasets, interactive dashboards, and research outputs by Juan Moisés de la Serna Tuya (UNIR). 92+ DOIs published across Harvard Dataverse, Zenodo, Mendeley, and Figshare.

## Author
Juan Moisés de la Serna Tuya (UNIR — Universidad Internacional de La Rioja)
ORCID: 0000-0002-8401-8018
Email: jmsernatuya@gmail.com
Web: https://juanmoisesdelaserna.es
GitHub: https://github.com/juanmoisesd

## About
Independent researcher and software engineer specializing in open science, neuroscience, mental health epidemiology, and AI in education. All research outputs are published with open licenses (CC BY 4.0) and permanently archived with DOIs for maximum reusability.

## Research Areas
- Neuroscience & dementia epidemiology (Alzheimer's Disease in Latin America)
- Mental health workforce and access to care (Ibero-America)
- Human brain connectomics (structural DTI and functional fMRI)
- Generative AI in academic research and higher education
- Open data infrastructure for Latin American health research

## Key Repositories

### alzheimer-latinamerica-dashboard
Interactive dashboard on Alzheimer's Disease in Latin America (2000–2050), 8 countries.
DOI: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/UVHABW
URL: https://juanmoisesd.github.io/alzheimer-latinamerica-dashboard/

### mental-health-specialists-iberoamerica
Mental health and neurology specialists per 100k inhabitants across Ibero-America (2000–2026).
DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18984813
URL: https://juanmoisesd.github.io/mental-health-specialists-iberoamerica/

### human-brain-connectomics-structural-and-functional-connectivity-database
Database of human brain structural and functional connectivity data.
URL: https://juanmoisesd.github.io/human-brain-connectomics-structural-and-functional-connectivity-database/

### generative-ai-in-academic-research-database-on-usage-perception-and-productivity
Database on GAI usage, perception, and productivity in Latin American academia (2022–2025).
URL: https://juanmoisesd.github.io/generative-ai-in-academic-research-database-on-usage-perception-and-productivity/

### latamdata-py
Python package for one-line access to 38+ Latin American research datasets.
PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/latamdata-py/
DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15105434
